mathematical_contract.authority: the existing parameter_component_system production route remains authoritative; its ordered-graph fast path and one cylindrical-cell fallback now cover both smooth finite-event components and isolated singular vertices
mathematical_contract.singular_detection: every retained-axis critical point is evaluated against the lifted derivative and every lifted-axis critical point is evaluated against the retained derivative; an exact zero marks a shared isolated singular vertex, while policy uncertainty remains explicit
mathematical_contract.event_identity: the two critical systems and authored-domain systems merge exact-equivalent parameter pairs, OR-ing singular and domain-boundary provenance so a boundary singularity is classified once
mathematical_contract.interior_incidence: a real algebraic curve has even local half-branch incidence at an isolated interior singularity; odd certified incidence is rejected rather than completed with missing topology
mathematical_contract.boundary_incidence: clipping by the closed unit square may retain any number of the singular vertex's real half-branches, including one at a cusp corner
mathematical_contract.branch_transport: every incoming and outgoing monotone cell terminates at the exact singular parameter pair; no arbitrary analytic branch pairing is guessed through a node or higher-valence vertex
mathematical_contract.isolated_points: a selected singular event with zero in-square incidence is retained as one exact isolated parameter pair, so an acnode is not lost by distinct-root fiber counting
mathematical_contract.tube_certificate: the existing disjoint exact event tubes, rootless horizontal edges, gap-rank invariants, and branch-sign proof apply unchanged on each punctured side of the singular fiber
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact resultants, derivative evaluation, root isolation, incidence counting, and replay without a fixed refinement cap
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same topology construction; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits, and no approximate parameter, orientation, incidence, or geometry is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: positive-dimensional sharing between a component and either projection derivative, boundary-coincident components, and unsupported coefficient towers remain explicit boundaries
